stepExplanation: Change in flux = A * (B_final - B_initial) = 0.05 * (0.1 - 0.4) = 0.05 * (-0.3) = -0.015 Wb. The negative sign indicates the flux decreased.
stepBody: Calculate the change in magnetic flux using the formula: Change in flux = A * (change in B), where A = 0.05 m^2, B changes from 0.4 T to 0.1 T.
